title: rubus fruticosus subsp. corylifolius
intro: Rubus fruticosus subsp. corylifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan blackberry or Himalayan raspberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the management of various health conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rubus fruticosus subsp. corylifolius include its ability to improve lipid profiles, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
